criteria.reason: Seminar room 8.1% correct, but accommodation given as 2.5% instead of 3.8%; catering cited at superseded 3.7%.
Cites MWSTG/MWSTV and explains primary-source trustworthiness, but names non-existent authority 'BVMW' with fabricated URL; ESTV not named.
States 1.1.2024 effective date and mid-2024 knowledge cutoff, but lists outdated rates as current and omits 2027 accommodation-rate sunset.
Explicitly flags that flat-rate bundling makes tax classification uncertain and recommends separate line items.

factual_errors: Accommodation VAT rate is 3.8%, not 2.5%; 2.5% is the pre-2024 reduced rate
3.7% is the outdated accommodation rate; current rates since 1.1.2024 are 8.1%, 2.6%, 3.8%
No 'Eidgenössisches Zollamt BVMW' exists; the competent authority is the ESTV; the URL is invented
SR references garbled: MWSTG is SR 641.20, MWSTV is SR 641.201
Accommodation special rate is time-limited to end of 2027; extension pending in Parliament — not mentioned
summary: Gets the 8.1% normal rate right and flags bundling uncertainty, but states the wrong accommodation rate (2.5% instead of 3.8%), cites a fabricated authority (BVMW) with an invented URL instead of the ESTV, and omits the 2027 sunset of the accommodation rate.
